decisionsTitle: «Resetează clasamentul»: a race's results and its test «Start» wiped before the planned start
decisionsSection:
**The ask (2026-11-19, two days before Saturday's race).** The club tries «Cronometrare» before the race — a test «Start», a few finishes typed or pressed — and race day must start from zero. Until now that meant deleting every line of «Clasament» one «Șterge» at a time and pressing «Anulează startul», and a press waiting on a volunteer's phone without signal could still arrive afterwards and bring a test finish back.

**Decision.**

1. **«Resetează clasamentul» / “Reset the results”**, at the foot of «Clasament», in its own danger card — a closed fold with the red border, the registration erase card's shape — whose one outlined red button asks first. The question counts what goes, in Romanian and in English, by `countForm` (no ICU plural): «Se șterg toate cele N rezultate ale cursei — sosiri, timpi, stări, note și rândurile alergătorilor neînscriși.», «Se șterge și startul dat la HH:MM.» when a «Start» was given (a gun alone: «Nu e niciun rezultat; se șterge startul dat la HH:MM.»), and «Ce e pe telefoanele de la «Cronometrare» și n-a plecat încă se pierde. Nu se poate anula.» **Nobody wipes what they did not see**: the form posts what the page drew — how many results and the gun it saw — and the server refuses with CONFLICT when either is not what is stored; the page's banner says so in the reset's words («Între timp au venit rezultate noi sau startul s-a schimbat: nu s-a șters nimic.»). Done, the page comes back with the toast «Clasamentul a fost resetat.».
2. **Only before the start.** The server allows it only while the race's planned gun — `race_starts_at`, else `starts_at` (`plannedGunOf`) — is still ahead on its own clock. A test «Start» moves the finish line's gun, never the plan, so it does not close the reset. At and after the planned gun it refuses with its own code, `RESULTS_RESET_AFTER_START` («Clasamentul se poate reseta doar înainte de start.» / “The results can only be reset before the start.”), and the card draws the button disabled with that sentence; with nothing to wipe, disabled with «Nimic de resetat: niciun rezultat și niciun start dat.».
3. **Who.** The Administrator and the Superadministrator (`canResetResults`, written as `canPublishResults`: whoever makes the results public wipes them), asserted in the service; the card is drawn for nobody else and not at all on an event that takes no results. The Organizer keeps «Șterge» row by row.
4. **What, in one transaction under the event row's lock** — the lock every press of the line, every save of «Clasament» and «Start» already take, so none lands between the count and the delete: every `event_results` row of the event is deleted (the registered runners' and the runners typed by hand, whatever their state), and `race_gun_at` / `race_gun_by_staff_user_id` are cleared. Nothing else moves: the awards' rules, the age bands, «Clasament public», the elite list and its numbers, the registrations, their numbers and their check-ins stay, and nothing is ranked again — nothing is left. One audit row, `event.results_reset` with `{ results, gunCleared }`, never a name, a number or a time; «Istoricul sosirilor» shows it as a line of «Clasament» («a resetat clasamentul: N rezultate șterse, startul anulat»), saying why the presses and saves older than it have no row. A reset that finds nothing writes and records nothing. The public cache is told once.
5. **The phones' waiting presses.** «Cronometrare»'s island sends each press with the moment it was made on the server's clock. `recordFinish` refuses, before anything else, a press whose moment is older than the race's newest `event.results_reset` — an indexed read of the audit trail from that moment on (`audit_logs_entity_idx`), no migration — with `RESULT_PRESS_BEFORE_RESET`, settled on the phone with «apăsat înainte de resetarea clasamentului — nu mai contează» and never sent again; the retry of a press the trial recorded is refused the same way. Without it a queued press could still be stamped when a new «Start» is given in the seconds around the reset (a tap is the gun when heard up to ten seconds later). A press with no moment of its own — the plain form, scripts off — is the server's now, after any reset.

**Refused, and why.**

- A column on `events` for the reset's moment: the audit row already holds it, read by the indexed key «Istoricul sosirilor» uses; no migration two days before a race.
- Resetting after the start, undoing a reset, and the moments kept by «⏱ Prinde timpul» on other phones: not in this change. After the start a reset would wipe a real race; a kept moment gives its time only to the next press, which the rule above refuses when it is older than the reset.
- A fingerprint of every row instead of the count: the question promises «N rezultate», and a page whose count and gun are what is stored has seen what it wipes.

**Known limit.** A press whose claimed moment is more than five seconds ahead of the server's clock is stamped with the server's own time (§986's rule for a phone running fast), so a press of the trial from a phone whose measured clock was that wrong is not recognised as older than the reset; the question's warning about the phones stays.
changelogLine: - **«Resetează clasamentul» before the race** — at the foot of «Clasament», an Administrator wipes the trial runs in one asked press: every result, the runners typed by hand and the test «Start»; only until the planned start, the question counting what goes, and a press a phone kept from before it no longer counts. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a race whose planned start (`race_starts_at`, else `starts_at`) is still ahead, when an Administrator or a Superadministrator opens «Clasament», then a danger card «Resetează clasamentul» / “Reset the results” stands at the foot of the page, its one outlined red button asking first with a question that counts the results by `countForm` — «Se șterg toate cele N rezultate ale cursei — sosiri, timpi, stări, note și rândurile alergătorilor neînscriși.» —, names the start given and its hour when one was, and says that what waits unsent on the phones of «Cronometrare» is lost and that it cannot be undone, in Romanian and in English; confirmed, every `event_results` row of the event is deleted and `race_gun_at` / `race_gun_by_staff_user_id` cleared in one transaction under the event row's lock — the awards, the age bands, «Clasament public», the elite list and its numbers, the registrations, their numbers and their check-ins unchanged, another event's results untouched —, one `event.results_reset` audit row records `{ results, gunCleared }` and no name, «Istoricul sosirilor» shows it, and the page comes back with «Clasamentul a fost resetat.» and no result, «Cronometrare» saying again «Cursa nu a pornit încă.». Verification: integration `results/reset.test.ts`, `results/reset-page.test.ts`, `results/actions.test.ts`; unit `results/finish-history.test.ts`; e2e `results-reset.spec.ts` (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Resetează clasamentul», then the server refuses the Organizer, the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer and a member (FORBIDDEN), an event that is not a race (`RESULTS_NOT_OPEN`), a race whose planned start has come — a test «Start» pressed earlier does not close it — (`RESULTS_RESET_AFTER_START`, «Clasamentul se poate reseta doar înainte de start.» / “The results can only be reset before the start.”) and a post whose count of results or whose gun is not what is stored (CONFLICT), each writing nothing; the card is not drawn for another role nor on an event that takes no results, and once the planned start has passed it draws its button disabled with that sentence. Verification: integration `results/reset.test.ts`, `results/reset-page.test.ts`, `results/actions.test.ts`; unit `staff/roles.test.ts`; e2e `results-reset.spec.ts` (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a press on «Cronometrare» whose moment is older than the race's last «Resetează clasamentul» — queued on a phone without signal, or the retry of a press the trial recorded —, when it reaches the server, then it is refused `RESULT_PRESS_BEFORE_RESET`, nothing written, even when a «Start» given in the seconds around the reset would have stamped it, and its line on the phone says «apăsat înainte de resetarea clasamentului — nu mai contează» / “pressed before the results were reset — it no longer counts”; a press made after the reset is recorded as any other. Verification: integration `results/reset.test.ts`, `results/timing-page.test.ts`; e2e `results-reset.spec.ts` (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
